build_urdf_tree: build a URDFTree from parsed links and joints dictionaries to construct a robot kinematic hierarchy
init_exlinks: create extended link objects from parsed URDF links to prepare for tree construction
build_tree: connect parent and child links through joints to build the URDF kinematic tree structure
find_root: find the root node of the URDF tree or construct a virtual root for multiple disconnected roots
review_urdftree_class: review the URDFTree class that constructs a hierarchical tree from URDF links and joints
